services.name: Half Day Wade Fly Fishing Trip
services.desc: Rates Private Tour 1 Person: $350 2+ People: $200 per Person Duration 4 Hours What To Expect For Your Trip Utah Pro Fly Fishing provides half-day fly fishing trips suitable for all skill levels. The Park City area boasts some of Utah's finest fly fishing rivers, with the Provo River and Weber River just a 15-30 minute drive from Park City. Upon arrival, your guide will be waiting for you at the designated meeting location, which will be specified in your confirmation. Your guide will then outfit you with waders and boots and go over what the plan is for your trip. What’s Included? Because many of our clients fly in from out of town, we provide all the fly fishing equipment you will need.

services.name: Local Ice Fishing Tours
services.desc: Chris Chastain hails from Southern California, where the ocean and the waves were an integral part of his childhood and early teenage years. In addition to his love for surfing, he fostered a deep passion for fishing, dedicating his free moments to pursuing fish in California’s lakes and rivers. In 2008, Chris embarked on a new chapter by relocating his family to the scenic Park City, Utah. The move opened the door to a captivating world of fly fishing and ice fishing that Utah had to offer. Within a short span of time, Chris found himself irresistibly drawn to these pursuits and eventually embraced the role of a Fly Fishing Guide, earning a stellar reputation in the region.
